supporting_observations.claim: The repeated requests in the alerted interval targeted update.medledger.com over HTTPS tunnels through the explicit proxy. Requests are recorded at 13:37, 13:41, 13:47, 13:51, 13:56, 14:02, and 14:06 UTC; the 13:41 request was denied and the others shown were allowed.

The endpoint records associate these proxy connections with PID 3784, C:\Program Files\MediLedger\medledgerupd.exe, running as tom.weber. The process started shortly before the requests and exited shortly after the last one.
The observed destination, executable path, and roughly five-minute check cadence match the provided inventory description of the approved MediLedger updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy records show the CONNECT destination and tunnel metadata, not the encrypted HTTPS contents; they do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged beyond the recorded byte counts.
The stated winsec and Sysmon collection outage is for WS-ESTONE-01 from 13:25 to 14:00 UTC, not WS-TWEBER-01. Network and proxy sensors are reported as collected for all hosts.
claims_not_established: The logs do not establish the contents or purpose of the encrypted MediLedger sessions, or whether an update was downloaded or applied.
The supplied records do not establish the MediLedger executable's signature, hash, or integrity.
unrelated_findings: Separately review tom.weber's SQL activity: sqlcmd queried a local SQLEXPRESS instance and then requested up to 100 rows from dbo.Users on DB-SRV-01; the available inventory does not identify DB-SRV-01 or establish whether this access was authorized. This does not determine the disposition of the alerted updater traffic. (T086-00065, T086-00116, T086-00122)

Separately validate workstation-to-workstation activity involving 10.51.10.24 and WS-TWEBER-01. The address is associated with WS-ESTONE-01 in network records; a network logon to WS-TWEBER-01 names tom.weber and source address 10.51.10.24, and WS-ESTONE-01 later established TLS to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443. The purpose of that TLS session is not established; the inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-RPATEL-01. This activity is outside the alerted outbound updater series. (T086-00062, T086-00063, T086-00064, T086-00328, T086-00330, T086-00332)
